title_en: At Oasis Residence, 2+1+2 Apartment For Sale With Super Layout!!
description_en: At Oasis Residence, 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale with Super Layout. The apartment is located on the 2nd residential floor, the newly completed building, part of Oasis Residence, which is known for its quality work, where thermal insulation, thermal facades, electrical-hydraulic installations, multisplit air conditioning systems, etc. are noted. The apartment has a total area of ​​111.79m2 and a net area of ​​97.9m2 and is organized by the entrance corridor which divides the premises, the living room with the kitchen corner which has windows, two bedrooms, two bathrooms where one has a window, as well as a spacious balcony. The orientation is from the South-East, which offers sun and light throughout the day. The property is in the mortgage process and the certificates are expected to be issued very soon.
